candidates.title: 정확히 한 번의 의미 구조
candidates.concept_granularity: single delivery guarantee built from two parts - the idempotent producer stopping retry duplicates and transactional semantics giving stream processing exactly-once handling

candidates.title: 멱등성
candidates.concept_granularity: single property of an operation whose repeated execution leaves the same result as one execution

candidates.title: 재전송 중복 시나리오
candidates.concept_granularity: single duplication path in which the leader replicates a record and crashes before answering, so the producer times out, resends, and the new leader stores the record twice

candidates.title: 멱등적 프로듀서
candidates.concept_granularity: single producer feature detecting and dropping duplicates caused by producer, network or broker errors, which cannot stop an application sending the same message twice itself

candidates.title: 프로듀서 ID와 시퀀스 넘버
candidates.concept_granularity: single message identity formed by the broker-assigned producer id plus a per-topic-partition sequence number, where the broker accepts a batch only when its sequence is one past the last it stored

locators.heading: ## 멱등적 프로듀서 > ### 멱등적 프로듀서의 작동 원리

candidates.title: max.in.flight.requests.per.connection
aliases: 응답 없이 보낼 수 있는 배치 수
candidates.concept_granularity: single cap on how many message batches one connection may have outstanding without an acknowledgement, which also bounds how many sequence numbers a partition must track

locators.heading: ## 멱등적 프로듀서 > ### 멱등적 프로듀서의 작동 원리

candidates.title: 중복 거부는 예외를 던지지 않는다
candidates.concept_granularity: single observability gap in which a rejected duplicate is logged and counted but raises no exception, so it is visible only through the producer's record-error-rate and the broker's ErrorsPerSec

locators.heading: ## 멱등적 프로듀서 > ### 멱등적 프로듀서의 작동 원리

candidates.title: Out Of Order Sequence Number
candidates.concept_granularity: single broker error raised when a batch arrives with a sequence number past the expected one, most often because in-flight batches overtook each other, after which the retry still stores every message once and in order

candidates.title: 무시해도 되는 시퀀스 에러
candidates.concept_granularity: single operating rule that without transactions the out-of-order sequence error needs no application recovery, because the producer already treats it as retriable and its own retry restores exactly-once delivery

candidates.title: 트랜잭션의 순서 요구
candidates.concept_granularity: single atomicity requirement that message order be absolute inside a transaction, so a broken sequence makes Kafka fence the producer and the application must abort and rebuild the instance

candidates.title: 좀비 프로듀서
candidates.concept_granularity: single hazard of a briefly disconnected producer returning to commit part of a transaction the replacement already aborted, splitting one transaction into a partly committed and partly failed state

candidates.title: 멱등적 프로듀서의 순서 보장 범위
candidates.concept_granularity: single boundary on the ordering idempotence gives: within one producer session and one topic partition only, not across partitions and not across a restart that assigns a new producer id

candidates.title: 시퀀스 간격이 드러내는 유실
candidates.concept_granularity: single loss path in which an unclean election promotes a lagging follower, so the producer's next batch lands far past the new leader's last sequence and the skipped messages are gone for good since the producer believes they were stored

candidates.title: 시퀀스 간격으로 원인 진단
candidates.concept_granularity: single diagnostic reading the gap in the logged sequence numbers - small and sporadic means in-flight reordering, large and persistent means real loss to be closed with unclean election off and acks=all

candidates.title: 프로듀서 재시작과 새 PID
candidates.concept_granularity: single blind spot in which a restarted producer receives a fresh producer id, so messages identical to the failed instance's carry different identities and the broker cannot see them as duplicates

candidates.title: 프로듀서 상태 복제
candidates.concept_granularity: single reason a newly elected leader already knows which sequence numbers to expect: followers update their own in-memory producer state on every replicated message

candidates.title: 프로듀서 상태 스냅샷
candidates.concept_granularity: single durability mechanism writing producer state to a file on shutdown and on each new segment, so a restarted broker rebuilds the sequence state from the snapshot plus replicated records, or from an older snapshot and the newest segments after a crash

candidates.title: 멱등적 프로듀서의 한계
candidates.concept_granularity: single boundary confining the guarantee to duplicates the producer's own retry logic creates, leaving a double send() call or two instances sending the same message uncaught

candidates.title: enable.idempotence
candidates.concept_granularity: single producer switch, on by default since Kafka 3.0, adding record metadata the broker uses to drop retry duplicates, at the cost of one extra startup call and 96 bits per batch
